changeSet.comment: The instance model for personal conversations, one for each declared tier. Removing the model removes its slot.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE personal_model_assignment ADD CONSTRAINT ck_personal_model_assignment_tier CHECK (tier IN ('CLOUD', 'IN_HOUSE', 'UNDECLARED'))
ALTER TABLE personal_model_assignment ADD CONSTRAINT ck_personal_model_assignment_tier_declared CHECK (tier <> 'UNDECLARED')

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The two monthly caps of the personal purse. NULL leaves personal AI unconfigured, so it is off.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE instance_llm_settings ADD CONSTRAINT ck_instance_llm_settings_personal_budgets CHECK ( (personal_monthly_budget_usd IS NULL OR personal_monthly_budget_usd >= 0) AND (personal_account_monthly_budget_usd IS NULL OR personal_account_monthly_budget_usd >= 0))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE instance_llm_settings DROP CONSTRAINT ck_instance_llm_settings_personal_budgets, DROP COLUMN personal_account_monthly_budget_usd, DROP COLUMN personal_monthly_budget_usd

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: When the person confirmed that their AI choice also covers personal conversations.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A personal call has no workspace and no run; the personal purse pays, and its payer is the account. An open personal call needs its attempt's epoch, a deadline after which a sweeper settles it, and the bound that the purse holds.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE llm_usage_event ADD COLUMN payer_account_id BIGINT, ADD CONSTRAINT sfk_llm_usage_event_payer_account FOREIGN KEY (payer_account_id) REFERENCES account (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_payer CHECK (payer_account_id IS NULL OR source_type = 'PERSONAL_CONVERSATION'), ALTER COLUMN source_id DROP NOT NULL, -- Only the erasure of a personal call's payer removes its source, which is the person's attempt. ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_source CHECK (source_id IS NOT NULL OR (source_type = 'PERSONAL_CONVERSATION' AND payer_account_id IS NULL)), DROP CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_source_type, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_source_type CHECK (source_type IN ('REVIEW_JOB', 'CONVERSATION_TURN', 'PRACTICE_SCRIPT_DECISION', 'PRACTICE_SCRIPT_EMBEDDING', 'PRACTICE_SCRIPT_RERANKING', 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DRAFT', 'PROBE', 'PERSONAL_CONVERSATION')), DROP CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_scope, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_scope CHECK ( (source_type = 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DRAFT' AND workspace_id IS NULL AND (run_id IS NULL OR (lease_epoch IS NOT NULL AND action_id IS NULL)) AND funding_source = 'INSTANCE' AND model_kind = 'CHAT' AND practice_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL) OR (source_type = 'PROBE' AND run_id IS NULL AND lease_epoch IS NULL AND action_id IS NULL AND source_attempt = 0 AND model_kind = 'CHAT' AND practice_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL AND ((workspace_id IS NULL AND funding_source = 'INSTANCE') OR (workspace_id IS NOT NULL AND funding_source = 'WORKSPACE'))) OR (source_type = 'PERSONAL_CONVERSATION' AND workspace_id IS NULL AND run_id IS NULL AND action_id IS NULL AND funding_source = 'INSTANCE' AND model_kind = 'CHAT' AND practice_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL) OR (source_type NOT IN ('PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DRAFT', 'PROBE', 'PERSONAL_CONVERSATION') AND workspace_id IS NOT NULL)), DROP CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_open_call, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_open_call CHECK (call_state <> 'OPEN' OR (source_type = 'PROBE' AND settle_after IS NOT NULL) OR (source_type = 'PERSONAL_CONVERSATION' AND settle_after IS NOT NULL AND lease_epoch IS NOT NULL AND payer_account_id IS NOT NULL AND cost_bound_usd IS NOT NULL) OR (run_id IS NOT NULL AND lease_epoch IS NOT NULL)); -- The personal purse sums one UTC month of personal rows, and an erasure selects them by payer. CREATE INDEX idx_llm_usage_personal ON llm_usage_event (occurred_at, payer_account_id) WHERE source_type = 'PERSONAL_CONVERSATION'; -- An account's deletion checks its payer rows through this index. CREATE INDEX idx_llm_usage_payer ON llm_usage_event (payer_account_id) WHERE payer_account_id IS NOT NULL;

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX idx_llm_usage_payer; DROP INDEX idx_llm_usage_personal; DELETE FROM llm_usage_event WHERE source_type = 'PERSONAL_CONVERSATION'; ALTER TABLE llm_usage_event DROP CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_source, ALTER COLUMN source_id SET NOT NULL, DROP CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_open_call, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_open_call CHECK (call_state <> 'OPEN' OR (source_type = 'PROBE' AND settle_after IS NOT NULL) OR (run_id IS NOT NULL AND lease_epoch IS NOT NULL)), DROP CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_scope, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_scope CHECK ( (source_type = 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DRAFT' AND workspace_id IS NULL AND (run_id IS NULL OR (lease_epoch IS NOT NULL AND action_id IS NULL)) AND funding_source = 'INSTANCE' AND model_kind = 'CHAT' AND practice_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL) OR (source_type = 'PROBE' AND run_id IS NULL AND lease_epoch IS NULL AND action_id IS NULL AND source_attempt = 0 AND model_kind = 'CHAT' AND practice_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL AND ((workspace_id IS NULL AND funding_source = 'INSTANCE') OR (workspace_id IS NOT NULL AND funding_source = 'WORKSPACE'))) OR (source_type NOT IN ('PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DRAFT','PROBE') AND workspace_id IS NOT NULL)), DROP CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_source_type, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_source_type CHECK (source_type IN ('REVIEW_JOB', 'CONVERSATION_TURN', 'PRACTICE_SCRIPT_DECISION', 'PRACTICE_SCRIPT_EMBEDDING', 'PRACTICE_SCRIPT_RERANKING', 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DRAFT', 'PROBE')), DROP CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_payer, DROP CONSTRAINT sfk_llm_usage_event_payer_account, DROP COLUMN payer_account_id;
